meta.title: Food Courts
meta.description: Food on the XLRI Delhi-NCR campus: a 24×7 cafeteria, The Daily Spot, an air-conditioned two-floor mess and NESCAFE Break Zone.

title: Food Courts
intro: From full meals in the mess to a late-night coffee, there is somewhere to eat on campus at any hour.

services.title: Cafeteria
services.description: The campus features a 24×7 cafeteria that offers a wide range of dining options, from full meals to quick snacks. This ensures that students have access to nutritious food at any time of day.

photos.alt: The cafeteria counter, with shelves of snacks and drinks behind it
Tables and chairs in the cafeteria

services.title: The Daily Spot (PJ Cafeteria)
services.description: Recently introduced, The Daily Spot (PJ Cafeteria) is a new cafeteria on campus offering a diverse menu. This adds to the variety of dining options available, catering to different tastes and preferences.

photos.alt: The Daily Spot lit up at night, with arched windows and a terrace
Tables under hanging lamps inside The Daily Spot
The tiled hallway and arched windows of The Daily Spot
The Daily Spot building from above, with the campus beyond

services.title: Mess Facility
services.description: The campus mess is a fully air-conditioned dining facility that spans two floors, providing a comfortable environment for students to enjoy their meals. The mess serves a range of nutritious dishes, ensuring students have access to balanced meals throughout their stay.

photos.alt: Long rows of tables in the air-conditioned mess

services.title: NESCAFE Break Zone
services.description: A refreshing café for quick bites! It’s the perfect spot for students to satisfy their late-night food cravings.

photos.alt: The NESCAFE Break Zone kiosk lit up at night
The NESCAFE Break Zone kiosk by day
